mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.1%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signal strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates a supply shock or contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production trend (INDPRO) indicates weakening supply capacity, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000, it signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
